S051-PERIOD: Conditional on the preceding eigenvector construction and (5.2), the nested exponent 29^(29^2) is consistent. For either nonzero eigenvalue t in GF(29^2), t^840=1. Iterating (5.2) gives lambda(29^840 n)=lambda(n), and applying the initial c(29m) decomposition at m=29^840 n gives c(29^841 n)=c(29n). The eigenvalue t=3mu-3 is nonzero because mu=1 does not satisfy the scan50 quadratic (its value is -2 modulo29). This verifies the deduction from the stated hypotheses; it does not prove those modular identities.
